subject: Genetics
title: COVID-19 Variants
description: A micro-lesson that makes COVID-19 Variants usable.

hook.text: In 2020, SARS-CoV-2 was one virus. By 2022, Alpha, Delta, and Omicron had rewritten the pandemic.

buildup.text: RNA viruses mutate fast—no proofreading enzymes. Each infection spawns billions of copies, each slightly different.

discovery.text: The Delta variant's spike protein mutations made it 60% more transmissible. One amino acid change dominated the planet.

climax.text: COVID taught the world evolution in real time. Every variant was natural selection on a global stage.

punchline.text: A pandemic taught billions what evolution looks like.

quiz.question: Why do RNA viruses mutate so fast?
